notes.subject: הצפרה
notes.rationale: 'tshefo ya dikahare' kapa 'phetoho ya merero' — ba-fetoleli ba fapana: KJV 'the morning', JPS 'the turn', ASV 'thy doom'.

notes.subject: צץ/פרח
notes.rationale: Mantsoe a mabeli a bontshang ho tsutsuma le ho tswala a latelana — sesupo sa peo e hlahang se sa bonahale Sesothong.

notes.subject: ⟨letsatsi⟩
notes.rationale: Seheberu se na le sehlopha se le seng; Sesotho se hloka sebapadi le sehlomathiso.

notes.subject: בonang
notes.rationale: הנה e bitsa mobadi hore a shebe — tlamo ya kutlo sebakeng sa prophete.

translation: Bonang, ⟨letsatsi⟩, bonang, le fihlile; e tswile tshefo, mme molamu o tsutsumetse, mme boikhantsbo bo tswaletse.
